title: IITM Pravartak Announces Batch 03 of Advanced Certificate in Applied Artificial Intelligence & Deep Learning
description: Chennai (Tamil Nadu) [India], August 29: As enterprises progress from testing artificial intelligence in isolated use cases to embedding it within core operations, the ability to build AI systems that perform reliably at scale has become increasingly important. Against this backdrop, IITM Pravartak, Technology Innovation Hub of IIT Madras, in collaboration with TimesPro, has announcedBatch 03 of its Advanced Certificate in Applied Artificial Intelligence & Deep Learning programme. The programme will help professionals develop the technical depth and applied expertise required to design, deploy and use AI solutions in complex enterprise environments.
